role: Canonical scientific diagram specifications; illustrative unless explicitly labelled otherwise

figures.title: One omnivore, two feeding pathways
lines: Leaves → herbivorous insect → bear: secondary consumer
figures.note: Trophic role follows the specified pathway, not a permanent species rank.

figures.title: Read arrows from food toward its consumer
lines: Dead material from all levels → decomposers
figures.note: This supplied web does not include hare → wolf. Missing links are not proof of impossibility.

figures.title: Production over the same area and year
figures.units: kJ per stated area per year
figures.note: 12% is calculated for the first transfer; 10% is assumed for the next. Illustrative.

figures.title: Compare concentration, not total chemical amount
figures.note: Illustrative cross-level samples. This is not one organism followed through time.

figures.title: The same plot can have different-shaped inventories
figures.note: Illustrative snapshot. Counts and standing masses cannot give energy-transfer efficiency.

figures.title: Standing stock is not production over time
lines: Standing producer biomass: 4 g dry mass per m²
Production: 2 g dry mass per m² per day
figures.note: A constant rate is assumed. Production is not the same as net change in standing stock.

figures.title: Equal energy and mass, different temperature changes
figures.note: Illustrative: no losses or phase change. Water's inferred heat capacity is three times X's.

figures.title: Depth profiles: evidence for a mixing question
figures.note: Illustrative samples. Similar temperatures do not establish uniform oxygen or complete mixing.

figures.title: A pond budget has an explicit boundary and interval
figures.note: Illustrative one-week account. Groundwater is omitted, not measured to be zero.

figures.title: Carbon enters, transfers within, and leaves a forest
figures.note: Illustrative carbon units over one year. Exported carbon is not necessarily immediately atmospheric.

figures.title: Track nitrogen's form as well as its location
lines: N₂ → fixation → reduced biologically available nitrogen
figures.note: Simplified pathways; organisms and environmental conditions determine which transformations occur.

figures.title: A seasonal nitrogen budget is not a nitrate test
lines: Residual storage change = +5 kg N per hectare
figures.note: Illustrative seasonal balance. Chemical form and unmeasured transfers still matter.

figures.title: Distinguish weathering, combustion and deposition
lines: Soil-water sulfate → plant uptake → biological transfers
Atmospheric reactions and transport → wet / dry deposition
figures.note: Simplified routes, not emission measurements. Never identify or test hazardous gases by smell.

figures.title: Enrichment is a conditional mechanism, not a guarantee
lines: Additional limiting nutrient → potential producer growth
More organic material → potential increase in respiration
Oxygen consumption versus production and exchange → net change
figures.note: Light, mixing, temperature and other conditions matter. The arrows are a hypothesis to test.

figures.title: Build an inference from several kinds of evidence
figures.note: A reasoning diagram, not a fossil photograph or measured timeline. One undated specimen is insufficient.
